$comment: Foundation Lab verification profile. The foundation defines tier semantics (verify-fast / verify-module / verify-full); this file defines the commands. FAST must stay cheap enough to run often.

fast.name: types
fast.$comment: Node strips types at runtime and never checks them, so without this every annotation in the repository is decorative. Cheap enough for FAST.

fast.name: app-builds
fast.command: FL_DATABASE_PATH=':memory:' FL_OTLP_ENDPOINT='' node -e "import('./src/spine/app.ts').then(m => { const a = m.buildApp(); if (a.routes.length === 0) throw new Error('no routes composed'); a.close(); })"

fast.name: authorization-heartbeat
fast.$comment: Tenant isolation is the property most costly to break silently, so it is checked at FAST as well as MODULE.

fast.name: mcp-serves
fast.$comment: The MCP transport is a second process entry point over the same contracts; a cheap check that it still starts and lists tools.

fast.name: ai-golden-heartbeat
fast.$comment: Recorded provider by default. A live heartbeat is 3 cases and, because one retry is permitted for transport failures, at most 6 provider calls.

triage.name: capability-evals
triage.$comment: Recorded provider: spends no subscription capacity. Live runs are FL_EVAL_PROVIDER=live and are budgeted at 40 calls, enforced in the runner.

deployment.$comment: Run against a DEPLOYED environment, not a source tree. The base URL is the environment under test; these prove the deployment is the artifact that was authorized and that it works.

dev.name: artifact-identity
dev.$comment: The live deployment must report the exact digest that was deployed. A mismatch means something other than the authorized artifact is running.
